planning.redesign: Replace timestamp-only reuse with producer-owned input and output projections; record include, macro execution and lookup observations
planning.gain: Zero eligible compile actions on an admitted no-change request; leaf invalidation follows actual consumers
planning.addedCost: Snapshot validation, content comparison, dependency index and capability mediation
planning.openCondition: Arbitrary macro/eval/native effects require mediation or denied reuse; timestamps are not semantic identity

frontend.redesign: Own mutable expander registry, lexical identity and optimizer state per admitted session; share immutable products only
frontend.gain: Independent Scheme modules may expand concurrently without a single shared import critical section
frontend.addedCost: Session construction or worker processes, immutable export encoding and fresh phase instantiation
frontend.openCondition: Do not remove locks before shared-state and macro side-effect isolation is established

readiness.redesign: Replace one module completion with consumer-specific phase and runtime prerequisites, publishing coherent generated groups
readiness.gain: A consumer can start before unrelated runtime compilation only when its phase closure is already executable
readiness.addedCost: More completion states, phase dependency edges, output manifests and failure propagation
readiness.openCondition: SSI can load runtime support; compiled transformer helpers and imported effects can still require native artifacts

execution.redesign: Unify module, native and follow-up admission; delegate capacity when a parent waits; retain resources until physical termination
execution.gain: Bound nested concurrency and overlap generation with necessary native work
execution.addedCost: CPU and memory reservations, cancellation custody, attempt-owned outputs and drain tracking
execution.openCondition: Existing unit-credit QNT does not prove weighted nested fairness, process isolation or actual memory bounds
